items.syllabus_item: 4.1 flanged T L beam effective width

body.en:
Key characteristics:

  • A T-beam consists of a web and slab flange on both sides; an L-beam has flange on one side.
  • The flange participates in compression when bending places the slab in compression and slab and web act together.
  • Effective width is smaller than or equal to the actual available width; non-uniform stress and shear lag limit participation.
  • Advantages include greater compression area and flexural efficiency without making the entire beam equally wide.

For qualifying monolithic construction, IS 456 clause 23.1.2 gives bf = l0/6 + bw + 6Df for a T-beam and bf = l0/12 + bw + 3Df for an L-beam, subject to actual available flange width and applicable conditions. l0 is the distance between points of zero moment; determine it from the structural behaviour and code. Isolated beams and other conditions have different provisions.
body.gu:
મુખ્ય characteristics:

  • T-beam માં web ની બંને બાજુ slab flange છે; L-beam માં એક બાજુ flange છે.
  • Bending થી slab compression માં હોય અને slab તથા web સાથે કાર્ય કરે ત્યારે flange compression માં ભાગ લે છે.
  • Effective width actual ઉપલબ્ધ width કરતાં વધુ નથી; non-uniform stress અને shear lag ને કારણે આખી પહોળાઈ સમાન રીતે કાર્ય કરતી નથી.
  • ફાયદામાં વધુ compression area અને આખા beam ને સમાન પહોળાઈ આપ્યા વગર વધુ flexural efficiency છે.

યોગ્ય monolithic construction માટે IS 456 clause 23.1.2 મુજબ T-beam માટે bf = l0/6 + bw + 6Df અને L-beam માટે bf = l0/12 + bw + 3Df છે, actual ઉપલબ્ધ flange width અને લાગુ conditions ની મર્યાદામાં. l0 એટલે points of zero moment વચ્ચેનું અંતર; structural behaviour અને code મુજબ નક્કી કરો. Isolated beams તથા અન્ય conditions માટે અલગ provisions છે.

h.gu: 4.2 Neutral axis flange માં હોય ત્યારે

body.en: If xu ≤ Df, the entire compression block lies within the flange and the section is analysed as a rectangular section of width bf. For yielded tensile steel: xu = 0.87fy Ast/(0.36fck bf), Mu = 0.87fy Ast(d − 0.42xu). Verify the assumed neutral-axis location and xu ≤ xu,max. If either condition fails, change the model or use strain compatibility as appropriate.
body.gu: જો xu ≤ Df હોય તો સમગ્ર compression block flange માં છે અને section ને bf width ધરાવતા rectangular section તરીકે analyse કરો. Yielded tensile steel માટે xu = 0.87fy Ast/(0.36fck bf), Mu = 0.87fy Ast(d − 0.42xu) છે. ધારેલ neutral-axis location અને xu ≤ xu,max તપાસો. કોઈ condition ખોટી હોય તો યોગ્ય model અથવા strain compatibility વાપરો.

h.gu: 4.3 Neutral axis web માં હોય ત્યારે

items.syllabus_item: 4.2 neutral axis in web and moment

body.en:
For xu > Df, separate the rectangular web contribution and the flange overhang. Let yf = Df when Df/xu ≤ 0.43; otherwise yf = min(0.15xu + 0.65Df, Df). For an under-reinforced section with yielded steel:

T = 0.87fy AstCw = 0.36fck bw xuCf = 0.45fck(bf − bw)yfT = Cw + CfMu = Cw(d − 0.42xu) + Cf(d − yf/2)

Solve equilibrium for xu, recheck its assumed region and the yf condition, and compare with xu,max. Use the appropriate IS 456 Annex G provisions rather than applying this yielded-steel equation to an over-reinforced section.
body.gu:
જો xu > Df હોય તો rectangular web contribution અને flange overhang અલગ લો. Df/xu ≤ 0.43 હોય તો yf = Df; અન્યથા yf = min(0.15xu + 0.65Df, Df). Yielded steel સાથે under-reinforced section માટે:

T = 0.87fy AstCw = 0.36fck bw xuCf = 0.45fck(bf − bw)yfT = Cw + CfMu = Cw(d − 0.42xu) + Cf(d − yf/2)

Equilibrium થી xu શોધી તેનું ધારેલ સ્થાન અને yf condition ફરી તપાસો તથા xu,max સાથે સરખાવો. Over-reinforced section માટે આ yielded-steel equation લગાવવાને બદલે યોગ્ય IS 456 Annex G provisions વાપરો.

body.en:
Steps:

  1. Find xu,max from the steel grade and effective depth.
  2. Determine whether xu,max is in the flange or web.
  3. Apply the matching compression block and lever arms, including the correct limiting flange-depth condition in IS 456 Annex G.
  4. For SP 16, select the correct flanged-section chart/table, ratios bf/bw, Df/d and material grades; interpolate only as directed and check units and limits.

Use actual section dimensions and reinforcement layout; shear, flange connection, serviceability and anchorage are separate checks.
body.gu:
પગલાં:

  1. Steel grade અને effective depth થી xu,max શોધો.
  2. xu,max flange માં છે કે web માં તે નક્કી કરો.
  3. IS 456 Annex G મુજબ યોગ્ય limiting flange-depth condition સહિત સંબંધિત compression block અને lever arms લગાવો.
  4. SP 16 માટે યોગ્ય flanged-section chart/table, bf/bw, Df/d ratios અને material grades લો; સૂચના મુજબ interpolation કરી units અને limits તપાસો.

Actual section dimensions અને reinforcement layout લો; shear, flange connection, serviceability અને anchorage અલગ checks છે.

body.en:
Given: For bf = 800 mm, Df = 80 mm, d = 450 mm, Ast = 800 mm², fck = 20 MPa and fy = 415 MPa, find moment resistance.

Step 1. Assume the neutral axis lies in the flange and calculate it.

xu = 0.87fy Ast / (0.36fck bf)xu = 0.87 × 415 × 800 / (0.36 × 20 × 800)xu ≈ 50.15 mm50.15 < Df = 80 mmxu,max = 0.48 × 450xu,max = 216 mm

Step 2. Calculate the flexural resistance.

Mu = 0.87fy Ast(d − 0.42xu)Mu = 0.87 × 415 × 800 × (450 − 0.42 × 50.1458) / 10⁶

Final answer:

Moment resistance ≈ 123.89 kN m for the stated assumptions.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: bf = 800 mm, Df = 80 mm, d = 450 mm, Ast = 800 mm², fck = 20 MPa અને fy = 415 MPa માટે moment resistance શોધો.

Step 1. Neutral axis flange માં છે તેમ ધારી તેની depth ગણો.

xu = 0.87fy Ast / (0.36fck bf)xu = 0.87 × 415 × 800 / (0.36 × 20 × 800)xu ≈ 50.15 mm50.15 < Df = 80 mmxu,max = 0.48 × 450xu,max = 216 mm

Step 2. Flexural resistance ગણો.

Mu = 0.87fy Ast(d − 0.42xu)Mu = 0.87 × 415 × 800 × (450 − 0.42 × 50.1458) / 10⁶

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આપેલ assumptions માટે moment resistance ≈ 123.89 kN m.

body.en:
Given: For bf = 800 mm, bw = 250 mm, Df = 80 mm, d = 450 mm, Ast = 1600 mm², M20 and Fe415, calculate flexural resistance.

Step 1. Calculate tension and test a flange-only neutral axis.

T = 0.87 × 415 × 1600T = 577680 Nxu,flange = 577680 / (0.36 × 20 × 800)xu,flange ≈ 100.29 mm100.29 > Df = 80 mm

Step 2. Solve equilibrium using the reduced flange depth.

yf = 0.15xu + 0.65Dfyf = 0.15xu + 52577680 = 0.36 × 20 × 250 × xu + 0.45 × 20 × 550 × (0.15xu + 52)xu ≈ 125.97 mmyf ≈ 70.90 mmDf / xu = 80 / 125.97Df / xu ≈ 0.635 > 0.43xu,max = 0.48 × 450xu,max = 216 mm

Step 3. Compute web and flange moments.

Cw = 0.36 × 20 × 250 × 125.97Cw ≈ 226747 NCf = 0.45 × 20 × 550 × 70.896Cf ≈ 350933 NMu = Cw(d − 0.42xu) + Cf(d − yf / 2)Mu ≈ 235.52 kN m

Final answer:

Flexural resistance ≈ 235.52 kN m; separate checks remain.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: bf = 800 mm, bw = 250 mm, Df = 80 mm, d = 450 mm, Ast = 1600 mm², M20 અને Fe415 માટે flexural resistance ગણો.

Step 1. Tension ગણી flange-only neutral axis તપાસો.

T = 0.87 × 415 × 1600T = 577680 Nxu,flange = 577680 / (0.36 × 20 × 800)xu,flange ≈ 100.29 mm100.29 > Df = 80 mm

Step 2. Reduced flange depth વાપરી equilibrium ઉકેલો.

yf = 0.15xu + 0.65Dfyf = 0.15xu + 52577680 = 0.36 × 20 × 250 × xu + 0.45 × 20 × 550 × (0.15xu + 52)xu ≈ 125.97 mmyf ≈ 70.90 mmDf / xu = 80 / 125.97Df / xu ≈ 0.635 > 0.43xu,max = 0.48 × 450xu,max = 216 mm

Step 3. Web અને flange moments ગણો.

Cw = 0.36 × 20 × 250 × 125.97Cw ≈ 226747 NCf = 0.45 × 20 × 550 × 70.896Cf ≈ 350933 NMu = Cw(d − 0.42xu) + Cf(d − yf / 2)Mu ≈ 235.52 kN m

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Flexural resistance ≈ 235.52 kN m; અલગ checks બાકી છે.

title.en: Numerical 4.3 — Limiting moment of a T-beam

body.en:
Given: Use bf = 800 mm, bw = 250 mm, Df = 80 mm, d = 450 mm, M20 and Fe415. Find limiting moment assuming a qualifying flange.

Step 1. Find limiting axis and select flange depth.

xu,max = 0.48 × 450xu,max = 216 mmDf / xu,max = 80 / 216Df / xu,max ≈ 0.370 < 0.43yf = Df = 80 mm

Step 2. Calculate limiting resistance of web and flange.

Mlim = 0.36fck bw xu,max(d − 0.42xu,max) + 0.45fck(bf − bw)yf(d − yf / 2)Mlim = 0.36 × 20 × 250 × 216 × (450 − 0.42 × 216) + 0.45 × 20 × 550 × 80 × (450 − 40)Mlim ≈ 302.05 × 10⁶ N mm

Final answer:

Limiting moment ≈ 302.05 kN m.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: bf = 800 mm, bw = 250 mm, Df = 80 mm, d = 450 mm, M20 અને Fe415 લો. યોગ્ય flange ધારણ કરી limiting moment શોધો.

Step 1. Limiting axis શોધી flange depth પસંદ કરો.

xu,max = 0.48 × 450xu,max = 216 mmDf / xu,max = 80 / 216Df / xu,max ≈ 0.370 < 0.43yf = Df = 80 mm

Step 2. Web અને flange ની limiting resistance ગણો.

Mlim = 0.36fck bw xu,max(d − 0.42xu,max) + 0.45fck(bf − bw)yf(d − yf / 2)Mlim = 0.36 × 20 × 250 × 216 × (450 − 0.42 × 216) + 0.45 × 20 × 550 × 80 × (450 − 40)Mlim ≈ 302.05 × 10⁶ N mm

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Limiting moment ≈ 302.05 kN m.

title.gu: Formulae, methods અને key data — યુનિટ 4

body.en:
Effective-width and stress-block equations are subject to code conditions.

bf,T = l0 / 6 + bw + 6Dfbf,L = l0 / 12 + bw + 3Dfyf = Df when Df / xu ≤ 0.43yf = min(0.15xu + 0.65Df, Df) when Df / xu > 0.43T = 0.36fck bw xu + 0.45fck(bf − bw)yfMu = 0.36fck bw xu(d − 0.42xu) + 0.45fck(bf − bw)yf(d − yf / 2)

Effective-width અને stress-block equations code conditions હેઠળ લાગુ છે.

bf,T = l0 / 6 + bw + 6Dfbf,L = l0 / 12 + bw + 3Dfyf = Df when Df / xu ≤ 0.43yf = min(0.15xu + 0.65Df, Df) when Df / xu > 0.43T = 0.36fck bw xu + 0.45fck(bf − bw)yfMu = 0.36fck bw xu(d − 0.42xu) + 0.45fck(bf − bw)yf(d − yf / 2)

q.en: What is a T-beam?
q.gu: T-beam શું છે?

a.en: A web with effective compression flange on both sides.
a.gu: બંને બાજુ effective compression flange ધરાવતો web.

q.en: What is an L-beam?
q.gu: L-beam શું છે?

a.en: A beam with flange mainly on one side.
a.gu: મુખ્યત્વે એક બાજુ flange ધરાવતો beam.

q.en: What is bf?
q.gu: bf શું છે?

q.en: What is bw?
q.gu: bw શું છે?

q.en: What is Df?
q.gu: Df શું છે?

q.en: Why use effective width?
q.gu: Effective width કેમ વાપરીએ?

a.en: Flange compression is non-uniform across the slab.
a.gu: Slab માં flange compression અસમાન છે.

q.en: When is a T-section rectangular in flexure?
q.gu: Flexure માં T-section ક્યારે rectangular બને?

a.en: When the neutral axis lies within the flange.
a.gu: Neutral axis flange ની અંદર હોય ત્યારે.

q.en: What if xu is in the web?
q.gu: xu web માં હોય તો શું કરવું?

q.en: What is yf?
q.gu: yf શું છે?

a.en: Equivalent depth for the flange overhang stress block.
a.gu: Flange overhang stress block ની equivalent depth.

q.en: Can bf exceed actual flange width?
q.gu: bf actual flange width થી વધુ હોઈ શકે?

a.en: No; applicable physical and code limits apply.
a.gu: નહીં; physical અને code limits લાગુ પડે છે.

q.en: What is l0?

a.en: Distance between points of zero moment.

q.en: Does a slab always act as a compression flange?
q.gu: Slab હંમેશા compression flange તરીકે કાર્ય કરે છે?

a.en: No; moment sign and composite action matter.
a.gu: નહીં; moment sign અને composite action મહત્વનાં છે.

q.en: Explain T-beam action and effective flange width.
q.gu: T-beam action અને effective flange width સમજાવો.

q.en: Calculate the moment resistance when the neutral axis lies in the flange.
q.gu: Neutral axis flange માં હોય ત્યારે moment resistance ગણો.

q.en: Calculate the moment resistance when the neutral axis lies in the web.
q.gu: Neutral axis web માં હોય ત્યારે moment resistance ગણો.

q.en: Determine limiting moment of a T-beam using IS 456 or SP 16.
q.gu: IS 456 અથવા SP 16 વડે T-beam નું limiting moment શોધો.

q.en: Distinguish T and L beams.
q.gu: T અને L beams વચ્ચે તફાવત આપો.

q.en: Define effective flange width.
q.gu: Effective flange width વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરો.

q.en: Define yf and state its use.
q.gu: yf વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરી તેનો ઉપયોગ લખો.

q.en: List conditions needed for flange action.
q.gu: Flange action માટે જરૂરી conditions લખો.
